run_titles_action: run the titles action to encode Wikidata titles into BPE token sequences and save them
run_titles_lang_trie_append: run the titles_lang_trie_append action to build a trie with titles followed by language codes
run_lang_titles_trie_append: run the lang_titles_trie_append action to build a trie with language codes prepended to titles
run_canonical_action: run the canonical action to build a canonical trie using language priority for Wikidata entities
review_preprocess_tries: review the preprocess_tries script that preprocesses Wikidata titles into BPE tries for mGENRE decoding
